counting_note: Do not pad the eight missing slots. E01 and E02 are speculative mathematical multi-section mechanisms, NOT evidence that Sanborn used them. They still require exact source-level overlap and source-degeneracy checks before admission. Their unknown historical support is not manufactured as a clue.

rejected_not_counted.reason: No measured two-class sidechannel. The 2005 attendee account attributes inconsistent spacing to hand layout and says no master letter-layout copy was preserved; it explicitly argues against this interpretation. Existing EXT-013 already covers physical-observable acquisition. Do not turn a manufacturing affordance into evidence of encoding.

Cutting and deburring are documented, but an intentional recoverable total order and symbol-to-route rule are absent. A chronology assay is evidence acquisition, not a specified cipher; no claim that surviving toolmarks encode an order.

rejected_not_counted.concept: Raw Morse dot/dash gap geometry as selector
rejected_not_counted.reason: Known Morse/extra-dot narratives and existing physical-mask work already supply the broad lead. No calibrated independent gap classes or operational mapping were located; the attendee report describes excess dots as spacing. Not counted as a new cipher.

Documented differences are not evidence of a K4 instruction bus. Deliberate-spelling, construction-error and source-version families already cover the broad issue; selecting only convenient differences would be circular.

rejected_not_counted.concept: Reflowed original worksheet row boundaries as a K4 route
rejected_not_counted.reason: An independently authenticated K4 worksheet placement and operational reading rule are missing. Earlier-chart reflow/physical-mask acquisition is already prior work, and simply extending an old route to another grid width is not a new mechanism.

rejected_not_counted.concept: K2 omitted-character aftermath as an intentional K4 instruction
rejected_not_counted.reason: A documented editing error and its unintended decoded aftermath cannot be promoted to a cipher instruction. Any source correction is a provenance choice, not a second mechanism or key clue.

rejected_not_counted.concept: Literal sliding K1-K3 source windows as K4 key
rejected_not_counted.reason: Direct duplicate of H-RUNKEY and EXT-047. New offsets, normalized text, keywords or larger corpora would not create a fresh mechanism.

rejected_not_counted.concept: Arithmetic interval codec using earlier-section probabilities
rejected_not_counted.reason: Merged with encoding agent's arithmetic-code proposal. The K1-K3 probability model is an independent parameter/source choice, not a distinct operator and must not be counted again.
